name: 52-budget-gemini3-pro-nodot-dispatch
description: The pro dispatch regex is /gemini-3[.\d]*-pro/ (:1305), where the character class is `*` (zero or more), so a bare 'gemini-3-pro' still reaches getGemini3ProBudget: reasoningEffort 'high' returns the effort string 'high' rather than the 32768 that getProBudget's 'high' would return. Expected value: 'high'.
